classes.EXACT_CLASS: A cited mechanism guarantees byte-identical reproduction within its declared environment; SHA-256 exact equality is permitted.
classes.BOUNDED_CLASS: Floating arithmetic may legitimately vary; only a pre-frozen numerical equivalence contract is permitted.
classes.PERSISTED_AUTHORITY: The immutable persisted object is authoritative; its persisted SHA is exact, while recomputation is only numerical evidence.
